headline: Frontline Bases Exchange Hands Amid Rising Losses
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago, the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has quickened across the contested hexes. Weathered Expanse now logs sixty‑three ownership changes in twenty‑four hours, with both Colonial and Warden casualties climbing past six hundred per hour and enlistments accelerating. Nevish Line follows with forty‑five flips and casualty rates exceeding six hundred per hour for each side, also accelerating. Linn Mercy records forty exchanges, its losses surging after a earlier lull. Mooring County shows twenty‑five flips and rising casualties, while Marban Hollow maintains a high turnover near nineteen events with Warden casualties accelerating. Stonecradle adds six flips and modestly accelerating enlistments. Meanwhile, Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily without base movement, and the majority of rear‑area hexes remain static. Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand each see only a handful of changes.
